POOL_COUNT.note: How much of a kind of mana a pool holds, after its symbol: `.mana-pool-entry b`.

TITLE.note: A prompt's question: the dock's `.prompt-title`, 26 points at weight 600, line height 1.15.

LONG_QUESTION_TITLE.note: The compact text of a long question in the action dock.

BUTTON.note: A button's label: `--button-font`, 24 points at weight 700, line height 1.

MENU.note: A menu row's label: `.table-menu`'s 14 points at line height 1.4 in `ui/src/table/menu.css`.

MENU_HINT.note: The key hint at a menu row's end: `.table-menu-hint`, 12 points.

TIP.note: A tooltip's words: `.tip` in `ui/src/design/components/tips.css`, 12.5 points at weight 600, line height 1.25.

FIELD.note: A text field's words: `.bug-text` in `ui/src/screens/styles/bug-report.css`, 15 points at line height 1.45.

OVERLAY_TITLE.note: An overlay's title: `.overlay-title` in `ui/src/design/components/overlay.css`, bold 64.5 points at line height 1.08.

OVERLAY_INSTRUCTION.note: An overlay's instruction under its title: `.overlay-instruction`, 22.8 points at line height 1.2.

PILL.note: The label of a small pill button over the table, such as Revealed Cards: `.stage-revealed .button` in `ui/src/stage/stage.css`, 14 points.

ENTRY.note: A catalog entry's words: `.stage-entry` in `ui/src/stage/choose.css`, 600 at 22 points.

WAY_CAPTION.note: The caption under a mode choice, measured on the stage in `.stage-way-says`.

LOG.note: A line of the game log: `.game-log-list`'s 14 points at line height 1.35.

LOBBY_DECK.note: The desktop lobby's deck heading: `.lobby-panel h2`, bold 20-point serif on a 23-point line.

LOBBY_COUNTS.note: The desktop lobby's deck counts under its heading: 16-point serif on an 18-point line.

LOBBY_LABEL.note: The desktop lobby's legends and labels: `.lobby-section legend, .lobby-panel label`, semibold 15-point sans on a 20-point line.

LOBBY_SETTING.note: A desktop game setting field's words: 16-point sans on a 22-point line.

OPENING_COIN_NUMBER.note: The first player's mark on the 44-point desktop coin, at 56 percent of its diameter.

FPS_MONITOR_LABEL.note: Units and secondary readings in the native client’s FPS monitor.

TIMING_REFUSAL.note: The word under the permanent that holds a player to sorcery speed: `.timing-refusal`, 16 points at weight 600.

GALLERY_TITLE.note: A gallery panel's numbered title: `.panel-title`, bold 26 points on a 34-point line.

GALLERY_CAPTION.note: A caption the gallery centres under a sample: `.caption` in a 240-point `.caption-at` box, 17 points on a 20-point line.

GALLERY_HEX.note: A color swatch's hex value: `.swatch small`, 14 points on an 18-point line.

GALLERY_LAND_COUNT.note: The count on the gallery's stack of lands, "×3": `.land-stack-count`, bold 22 points.

GALLERY_PRIMARY.note: The gallery's primary button sample: `.button-rows .button-primary`, 29.5 points.

GALLERY_SECONDARY.note: The gallery's secondary button sample: `.button-rows .button-secondary`, 24.5 points.

GALLERY_DISABLED.note: The gallery's disabled button sample: `.button-rows .button:disabled`, 28.5 points.

GALLERY_PILL.note: The priority pill in the gallery: `.panel-02 .priority-pill`, 20 points.

GALLERY_SCRY_TITLE.note: The title of the gallery's scry overlay, drawn at 0.35 of the overlay's size as `.scry-preview-inner` scales it.

TURN_BANNER_TITLE_GLOW_BLUR.note: The title's 18-point CSS text-shadow blur radius expressed as a drop-shadow blur length.

BUTTON_HEIGHT.note: Every action button on the game screen.

BUTTON_WIDTH.note: The width of every button in the action dock.

BUTTON_PADDING.note: A button's padding on either side of its label: the `.button` rule's 0.9em at `--button-font`.

PANEL_RADIUS.note: The radius of a panel's corners.

ICON.note: The side of the icon an icon button shows: `.icon-button > svg`.

SLIDER_TRACK.note: The height of a slider's track.

ORDER_ITEM_RADIUS.note: The radius of a waiting trigger in an order's row: `.stage-order-item`'s `border-radius`.

SLIDER_THUMB.note: The side of a slider's round thumb.

MENU_PADDING.note: The padding inside a menu's border: `.table-menu`'s `padding`.

MENU_RADIUS.note: The radius of a menu's corners.

MENU_ROW_HEIGHT.note: The least height of a menu row: `.table-menu-row`'s `min-height`.

MENU_ROW_RADIUS.note: The radius of the highlight behind a menu row.

MENU_CHECK.note: The column at a menu row's start that holds its check mark.

TIP_RADIUS.note: The radius of a tooltip's corners: `.tip`'s `border-radius`.

MENU_BORDER.note: The width of a menu's, a highlighted menu row's and a tooltip's border.

MENU_TITLE_PADDING_SIDE.note: The padding either side of a menu's title.

TIP_PADDING_X.note: The padding either side of a tooltip's words.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM.note: The width of an icon button's rim: the 1px inset ring of `.icon-button`'s `box-shadow`.

FIELD_PADDING_Y.note: A text field's padding above and below its text: `.bug-text`'s `padding: 10px 12px`.

FIELD_PADDING_X.note: A text field's padding on either side of its text: `.bug-text`'s `padding: 10px 12px`.

FIELD_BORDER.note: The width of a text field's border: `.bug-text`'s `border: 1px solid var(--metal)`.

FIELD_RADIUS.note: The radius of a text field's corners: `.bug-text`'s `border-radius`.

TRAY_PILE_RADIUS.note: The radius of a pile's box in a tray: `.stage-tray-pile`'s `border-radius`.

CARD_RADIUS.note: The corner radius of a card or zone pile.

OVERLAY_TOP.note: How far below the window's top an overlay's columns begin: `.overlay`'s top padding.

OVERLAY_LEFT.note: How far from the window's left edge an overlay's choice column begins: `.overlay`'s left padding.

OVERLAY_MAIN.note: The width of an overlay's choice column: the first of `.overlay`'s grid columns.

OVERLAY_SIDE.note: The width of an overlay's side column, which holds the source card: the second of `.overlay`'s grid columns.

OVERLAY_GAP.note: Between an overlay's two columns: the most of `.overlay`'s `column-gap`.

OVERLAY_HEADER.note: The height of an overlay's header, its title over its instruction: `.overlay-header`.

VIEWER_MIN_WIDTH.note: The pile viewer's minimum panel width: `.zone-viewer` in `ui/src/screens/styles/zone-viewer.css`.

VIEWER_CARD.note: The width of a card in the viewer's grid: `VIEWER_CARD` in `ui/src/game/Piles.tsx`.

VIEWER_COLUMNS.note: The most cards in a row of the viewer's grid: `VIEWER_COLUMNS` in `ui/src/game/Piles.tsx`.

VIEWER_GAP.note: Between the cards of the viewer's grid: `.zone-viewer-cards`'s `gap`.

VIEWER_HEIGHT.note: The most the viewer's grid shows before it scrolls, two rows of cards: `.zone-viewer-cards`'s `max-height`.

PILL_HEIGHT.note: The height of a small pill button over the table: `.stage-revealed .button`.

PILL_PADDING.note: A pill button's padding either side of its label.

PILL_CROSS.note: The side of the cross beside a pill that dismisses what it names: `.stage-revealed-dismiss`.

PILL_GAP.note: Between a pill and its cross: `.stage-revealed`'s `gap`.

LIFE_CHANGE_LEFT.note: The desktop life change's right edge is this far left of the orb center: `.life-change` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

LIFE_CHANGE_TOP.note: A gain starts this far below the orb art's top: `.life-change-gain` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

LIFE_CHANGE_BOTTOM.note: A loss starts this far above the orb art's bottom: `.life-change` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

ORB_HEIGHT.note: The height of a life orb's core: twice `CORE.ry`.

ORB_BEZEL.note: The width of a life orb's bezel: `BEZEL` in `Player.tsx`, the stroke of `.life-orb-core` in `ui/src/design/components/life-orbs.css`.

STEP.note: The side of a step stop's icon: `.step-stops`' `--step-size` in `ui/src/design/components/phase-tracker.css`.

POOL_GAP.note: Between the kinds of mana in a pool: `.mana-pool`'s `gap`.

STEPS_WIDTH.note: The width of each player's grid of step stops about their orb: `.turn-controls .step-stops` in `ui/src/screens/styles/controls.css`.

STEP_GAP.note: The gap between two columns of step stops: `--step-gap`.

STEP_ROW_GAP.note: The gap between the two rows of step stops: `--step-row-gap`.

THINKING.note: The side of the ring under the opponent's orb while they think: `.thinking` in `life-orbs.css`.

THINKING_TRACK.note: The width of that ring: `.thinking-track`'s stroke.

ENTRY_MIN_WIDTH.note: The least width of a catalog entry: `.stage-entry`'s `min-width`.

ENTRY_HEIGHT.note: The height of a catalog entry: `.stage-entry`'s `height`.

ENTRY_PADDING.note: A catalog entry's padding either side of its words: `.stage-entry`'s `padding`.

ENTRY_GAP.note: Between one catalog entry and the next: `.stage-entries ul`'s row `gap`.

LOG_FOLDED_HEIGHT.note: The folded game log's tallest list when opened: `.game-log-folded .game-log-list`'s `max-height`.

LOG_PADDING_X.note: The game log's padding either side: `.game-log-list`'s `padding`.

LOG_PADDING_Y.note: The game log's padding above and below: `.game-log-list`'s `padding`.

LOG_TURN_GAP.note: The room above a turn's heading in the game log: `.game-log-turn`'s `margin-top`.

OPENING_COIN_DIAMETER.note: The default size of the web's desktop `Coin`.

OPENING_COIN_LABEL_GAP.note: The gap from the coin to the play or draw label in `.opening-coin`.

BUG_HINT_LINE.note: The height of the desktop bug report hint's line: `.bug-hint` sets no line height, and WebKit's normal line for Open Sans at 15 points is 20 points.

GAME_OVER_BUTTONS_RIGHT.note: How far the result's dock stands in from the window's right edge: `.dock`'s `right` in `ui/src/screens/styles/controls.css`.

GAME_OVER_DIM_BLUR.note: The blur of the table under the game's result: `.table-dimmed`'s `blur(2.5px)` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

LOBBY_PANEL_GAP.note: The space between the desktop lobby panel's sections: `.start-panel.lobby-panel`'s `gap`.

LOBBY_SECTION_BORDER.note: The width of a desktop lobby section's border: `.lobby-section`'s `border`.

LOBBY_SECTION_RADIUS.note: The radius of a desktop lobby section's corners: `.lobby-section`'s `border-radius`.

LOBBY_SWITCH_BOX.note: The side of an assist's checkbox, as the browser draws `.lobby-assists input`.

LOBBY_SWITCH_LABEL_GAP.note: The space between an assist's checkbox and its label: `.lobby-assists label`'s `gap`.

LOBBY_SETTING_WIDTH.note: The width of a desktop game setting's number field: `.lobby-panel input[type="number"]`'s `10ch`, at 16 points.

LOBBY_SETTING_HEIGHT.note: The height of a desktop game setting's field: a 22-point line, `padding: 7px 10px` and a 1-point border.

LOBBY_SETTING_PADDING_Y.note: A desktop game setting field's padding above and below its text.

LOBBY_SETTING_PADDING_X.note: A desktop game setting field's padding on either side of its text.

LOBBY_FIRST_WIDTH.note: The width of the desktop lobby's 'First' box, as the web lays out its `select`.

FPS_MONITOR_DIGITS.note: The FPS monitor leaves room for three digits.

FPS_MONITOR_INDICATOR.note: The diameter of the FPS monitor's pacing indicator.

FPS_MONITOR_BAND.note: The room for the compact FPS monitor above the table: two lines of labels, for the target and the display link's rate.

FPS_MONITOR_TOGGLE.note: The width of the FPS monitor's On and Off control.

REFUSAL_PADDING_X.note: The padding either side of that line's words: `.inspect-refusal`'s `padding: 8px 12px`.

REFUSAL_PADDING_Y.note: The padding above and below that line's words.

TIMING_REFUSAL_RADIUS.note: The radius of the corners of the word under the permanent that holds a player to sorcery speed: `.timing-refusal`'s `border-radius`.

TIMING_REFUSAL_PADDING_X.note: The padding either side of that word: `.timing-refusal`'s `padding: 5px 10px`.

TIMING_REFUSAL_PADDING_Y.note: The padding above and below that word.

TIMING_REFUSAL_GAP.note: The gap between the bottom of the permanent and that word, as the web's `noticePlace` leaves it.

VIEWER_FADE.note: How far the cards fade out at an end of a pile viewer's list with more beyond it: `--fade` of `.zone-viewer-cards` in `ui/src/screens/styles/zone-viewer.css`.

LONG_QUESTION_EXTENSION.note: How far a long question extends to the left of the action dock.

QUESTION_TITLE_GAP.note: Extra space below the question, from the action dock's title margin.

GALLERY_TABLETOP_RADIUS.note: The radius of the gallery's tabletop swatch: `.tabletop-chip`.

GALLERY_PILE_RADIUS.note: The radius of each card under the top of a gallery pile.

GALLERY_LAND_COUNT_RADIUS.note: The radius of the gallery's land count badge.

GALLERY_SCRY_ZONE_RADIUS.note: The radius of the drop zone in the gallery's scry overlay.

GALLERY_FIELD_RADIUS.note: The radius of a gallery prompt's field.

PANEL.note: `--surface`, slightly translucent for a panel over the table.

DISABLED_RIM.note: A disabled button's rim: the `border-color` of `.button:disabled`.

DISABLED_INK.note: A disabled button's dim label: the `color` of `.button:disabled`.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM.note: An icon button's faint gold rim: the inset ring of `.icon-button`'s `box-shadow`.

ICON_BUTTON_RIM_HOVERED.note: An icon button's rim under the pointer: `.icon-button:hover`.

SLIDER_TRACK.note: The unfilled part of a slider's track, behind the `--gold` fill the web's `accent-color` gives a range input (`.sound-level input` in `ui/src/screens/styles/settings.css`).

SWEEP.note: The wash inside the rectangle a sweep over the manual table draws: `.selection-rectangle`'s `background` in `ui/src/table/selection.css`.

START_PANEL.note: The start and lobby panels' face: `.start-panel`'s `background: #29231f` in `ui/src/screens/styles/start-panel.css`.

START_PANEL_BORDER.note: The start and lobby panels' border: `.start-panel`'s `border: 1.5px solid #8a735a`.

START_PANEL_BORDER_TOP.note: The start and lobby panels' lighter top edge: `.start-panel`'s `border-top-color: #e9c88a`.

SWEEP_RIM.note: The line round a sweep's rectangle: `.selection-rectangle`'s `border`.

SELECTION_SUMMARY.note: The panel of the summary over the selected permanents on the manual table: `.selection-summary`'s `background` in `ui/src/table/selection.css`.

SELECTION_SUMMARY_RIM.note: The line round the selection summary: `.selection-summary`'s `border`.

DROP_HALF.note: A half of a library's drop outline not under the pointer: `.table-library-half`'s `background` in `ui/src/table/drag.css`.

DROP_HALF_INK.note: The label of the half of a library's drop outline under the pointer: `.table-library-half[data-over]`'s `color`.

MENU_ACTIVE.note: The highlighted menu row: `.table-menu-row[data-active]`'s `--gold` mixed 15% into `--surface`.

TRAY_PILE_RIM.note: The rim of a pile's box under the cards a split holds up: `.stage-tray-pile`'s `border` in `ui/src/stage/stage.css`.

BACKDROP.note: What darkens the table under an overlay: `.overlay-backdrop`'s `background`.

BACKDROP_FILTER_FALLBACK.note: The translucent surface drawn in Baseline in place of a panel's backdrop filter.

LIFE.note: A life total on its orb: the `color` of `.life-orb-total`.

ORB_CORE.note: A life orb's dark core: the `fill` of `.life-orb-core`.

STEP.note: A step stop's cream icon: the `fill` of `.step-icon`.

STEP_CURRENT.note: The current step's icon, burning gold: `.step-current .step-icon`.

THINKING.note: The gold of the ring under the opponent's orb while they think: the middle of `Thinking`'s arc.

TRAY_SHADE.note: What darkens the table while a prompt covers it: `.stage-tray`'s `background` in `ui/src/stage/stage.css`.

WAY_DISABLED_INK.note: The caption of a mode choice the player cannot use.

ENTRY_CHOSEN.note: The face of the catalog entry chosen: `.stage-entry[aria-pressed="true"]`'s `background`; its rim is `gold`.

LOG.note: The game log's face: the `background` of `.game-log-list` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

LOG_TEXT.note: A line of the game log: `.game-log-list`'s `color`, `--text-dim`.

LOG_TURN.note: A turn's heading in the game log: `.game-log-turn`'s `color`, `--gold`.

LOG_COUNTER.note: A countered spell's line in the game log: `.game-log-counter`'s `color`.

BANNER.note: The smoky shade behind the step banner: the middle stop of `.step-banner`'s gradient in `ui/src/screens/styles/step-banner.css`.

TURN_BANNER_TITLE.note: The turn announcement's title: `.turn-banner-title`'s `color`, the same for either player.

BANNER_TITLE.note: The step banner's gold title: the middle stop of `.step-banner-title`'s gradient.

OPENING_TITLE.note: The desktop opening heading's ink in `.opening-title`.

OPENING_COIN_NUMBER.note: The number on the opening coin, from `.coin`.

TURN_CAPTION.note: The caption under the prompt's primary button: `.turn-caption`'s `color`.

QUESTION_TITLE.note: The question above the action dock.

REFUSAL.note: The face of the inspector's line that says why a card can't be played: `.inspect-refusal`'s `background`; its words are `stat-down`.

TIMING_REFUSAL.note: The face of the word under the permanent that holds a player to sorcery speed: `.timing-refusal`'s `background`; its rim is `stat-down`.

GALLERY_PAGE.note: The gallery page under its panels: `.gallery`'s background color in `ui/src/screens/styles/gallery.css`.

GALLERY_PANEL_RIM.note: A gallery panel's border at its sides; its top is `#e9c88a` and its bottom `#a9895f`, lit from above.

GALLERY_LAND_COUNT.note: The dark numerals on the gallery's land count badge.

GALLERY_CAPTION_RULE.note: The faint line before the gallery's second and third scry captions: their left border.

W.note: A white mana symbol's disc: `.mana-w` in `ui/src/design/components/mana-symbols.css`.

U.note: A blue mana symbol's disc: the middle stop of `.mana-u`'s gradient.

GENERIC.note: The disc of a number or any other symbol: `.mana-generic`.

INK.note: A mana symbol's glyph: the `color` of `.mana-symbol`.

U_INK.note: A blue mana symbol's glyph: the `color` of `.mana-u`.

TURN_BANNER_COMPACT_SCALE.note: The fraction of desktop size at which `.phone-announce` draws a turn banner.

TURN_BANNER_START_SCALE.note: How large the turn banner is as it starts to fade in: `.turn-banner.stage-notice`'s `scale: calc(0.93 + 0.07 * ...)` in `ui/src/stage/stage.css`.

TURN_BANNER_SLIDE_AT.note: How far through its run the turn banner starts to slide away: `max(0, (var(--through) - 0.8) / 0.2)` in `.turn-banner.stage-notice`.

SMALL_SCALE.note: `button-small`: a small button is this share of a button's height and type size.

OPENING_HUD_OPACITY.note: How opaque the step stops stand while the opening hand overlay is up: `.table-dimmed[data-opening] .turn-controls`.

OPENING_COIN_EDGE_SCALE.note: The minimum projected width as the opening coin turns edge-on, as a share of its diameter.

OPENING_COIN_ROCK_RISE.note: The coin rocks this many em in either direction while the opponent chooses who starts, from `coin-choose`.

OPENING_COIN_LAND_RISE.note: The coin begins this many em above its settled position, from `coin-land`.

OPENING_COIN_LAND_TURNS.note: The number of full turns during the 1080-degree `coin-land` animation.

OPENING_COIN_LAND_EASE_X1.note: The first control point's horizontal coordinate in the `coin-land` easing curve.

OPENING_COIN_LAND_EASE_Y1.note: The first control point's vertical coordinate in the `coin-land` easing curve.

OPENING_COIN_LAND_EASE_X2.note: The second control point's horizontal coordinate in the `coin-land` easing curve.

GAME_OVER_DIM_BRIGHTNESS.note: How bright the table under the game's result stays: `.table-dimmed`'s `brightness(0.68)`.

GAME_OVER_DIM_SATURATE.note: How saturated the table under the game's result stays: `.table-dimmed`'s `saturate(0.85)`.

QUARTER.note: A quarter, to round a corner by.

WAY_DISABLED_GRAYSCALE.note: How far a way that cannot be chosen is desaturated: `grayscale(0.85)` of `.stage-way:disabled .stage-way-face` in `ui/src/stage/choose.css`.

WAY_DISABLED_BRIGHTNESS.note: How far a way that cannot be chosen is darkened: `brightness(0.55)` of `.stage-way:disabled .stage-way-face`.

BUTTON_HOVER_BRIGHTNESS.note: The brightness multiplier for an action button under the pointer, including the pass-on button's face in `ui/src/screens/styles/controls.css`.

WAY_FACE_RADIUS.note: The mode chooser's hover ring rounds by this share of its card's width.

PASS_ON_GLYPH_ASPECT.note: The pass-on glyph's height over its width: its artwork's view box is 24 by 16, so the web's 22-point-wide `svg` is 14.7 points tall.

SECONDARY.note: An action button that is not the primary one: `.button-secondary` in `ui/src/design/components/buttons.css`, a soft highlight along its top edge inside, a dark hairline ring and a drop shadow below.

PRIMARY.note: The primary action button: `.button-primary` in `buttons.css`, a warm highlight inside, a dark brown hairline ring, an amber glow and a drop shadow below.

DISABLED.note: Any disabled action button, whatever its style says: `.button.button:disabled` in `buttons.css`, a faint dark ring and no light or lift.

WAY_HIGHLIGHT.note: The gold ring and glow around a mode choice the pointer is over or the keyboard has focused.

WAY_CAPTION.note: The shadow under a mode choice caption, measured in stage pixels.

QUESTION_TITLE.note: The close shadow below an action dock question.

ICON_BUTTON.note: An icon button: `.icon-button` in `ui/src/design/components/icon-button.css`, its faint gold rim (a one-point ring inside its edge) and a soft drop shadow.

ICON_BUTTON_HOVERED.note: An icon button under the pointer or with the focus: `.icon-button:hover`, its rim brighter.

BUG_TOOLS.note: The bug report's tools pill: `.bug-tools` in `ui/src/screens/styles/bug-report.css`, a drop shadow that lifts it off any frozen frame.

LIFTED.note: A raised panel such as a menu (`.table-menu` in `ui/src/table/menu.css`): a near shadow and a broad far one.

SHEET.note: The phone's bottom sheet that holds a menu: `.phone-sheet` in `ui/src/mobile/phone.css`.

START_PANEL.note: The start and lobby panels: `.start-panel`'s `box-shadow`, a dark ring inside the border and a shadow under the panel.

BANNER_TITLE.note: The step banner title's drop shadows: `.step-banner-title`'s `filter` in `ui/src/screens/styles/step-banner.css`, a tight dark one under a soft one.

OPENING_TITLE.note: The near text shadow in `.opening-title`. A second, broader drop shadow would use extra blurred glyphs at Retina scale.

OPENING_COIN_LABEL.note: The play or draw label's text shadow in `.opening-coin`.

OPENING_COIN.note: The opening coin's brass rims and drop shadow in `.coin`. Its rims are 0.09 and 0.16 times the 24.64-point coin type size.

STEP_ICON.note: A step icon's drop shadow: `.step-icon`'s `filter` in `ui/src/design/components/phase-tracker.css`.

PHASE_ICON.note: A phase icon's drop shadow: `.phase-icon`'s `filter` in `phase-tracker.css`.

CURRENT_GLOW.note: The orange glow of the current phase's and the current step's icon: the three drop shadows of `.phase-current .phase-icon`'s and `.step-current .step-icon`'s `filter` in `phase-tracker.css`.

FULL_CONTROL.note: Full control's mark's drop shadow: `.full-control svg`'s `filter` in `ui/src/screens/styles/controls.css`.

PASS_ON.note: The pass-on button's glyph's dark brown drop shadow: `.pass-on-face > svg`'s `filter` in `controls.css`.

GALLERY_PANEL.note: A gallery panel's dark inner hairline and soft drop shadow: `.panel`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_RULE.note: The dark lines above and below a gallery panel's engraved rule: `.panel-rule`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_SWATCH.note: The ring and drop shadow under a gallery color swatch.

GALLERY_METAL_GOLD.note: The warm haze round the gallery's gold rule: `.metal-gold`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_METAL_SILVER.note: The dark line under the gallery's silver rule: `.metal-silver`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_SWATCH_LIGHT.note: The dark line, ring and drop shadow under the gallery's three light color swatches: `.swatch-chip`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_TABLETOP.note: The ring and drop shadow under the gallery's tabletop swatch.

GALLERY_LAND_COUNT.note: The dark ring and drop shadow under the gallery's land count badge.

GALLERY_PILE_FOOT.note: The shadow under the lowest card of a gallery pile, the web's `--shadow-card`.

GALLERY_TRACKER.note: The dark ring and drop shadow round the gallery's phase tracker: `.phase-tracker`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_PILL.note: The dark ring and drop shadow round the gallery's priority pill: `.priority-pill`'s `box-shadow`.

GALLERY_SOURCE_RING.note: The gold ring round the gallery's source card, where the web lights its `highlight="source"` card.

GALLERY_TARGET_RING.note: The cyan ring round the gallery's target card and its blocker.

GALLERY_ATTACK_RING.note: The ember ring round the gallery's attacker.

PRIMARY.note: The primary action button's face: `.button-primary` in `ui/src/design/components/buttons.css`, deep amber darkest just above its middle and bright at its foot.

SECONDARY.note: Any other action button's near-black face: `.button-secondary` in `buttons.css`.

TURN_BANNER_BAND.note: The dark strip underneath a turn announcement fades out toward the sides, as `.turn-banner-band` does.

BANNER.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 52% 54% at 50% 45%, rgb(12 10 9 / 88%), rgb(12 10 9 / 70%) 45%, rgb(12 10 9 / 30%) 75%, transparent)
BANNER.note: The smoky shade under a step announcement: `.step-banner` in `ui/src/screens/styles/step-banner.css`, darkest a little above its middle and fading out before its edges.

PHASE_TRACKER.note: The phase tracker's dark pill, lighter toward its foot: `.phase-tracker` in `ui/src/design/components/phase-tracker.css`.

OPENING_BACKDROP.note: The opening hand's backdrop, which leaves the opponent's side of the table clear: `.opening > .overlay-backdrop` in `ui/src/screens/styles/table.css`.

OPENING_COIN.note: The lit face of the opening coin in `.coin`.

LOG_MASK.note: The game log's mask, which fades its oldest lines out over its top 40 points: `.game-log-list`'s `mask-image` in `table.css`.

GALLERY_RULE.note: A gallery panel's engraved rule, fading out at both ends: `.panel-rule`'s `background`.

GALLERY_DIVIDER.note: The upright divider between gallery samples: `.specimen-divider`'s `background`.

GALLERY_WORDMARK_RULE.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(233 173 74 / 85%) 30%, rgb(255 226 170 / 95%) 50%, rgb(233 173 74 / 85%) 70%, transparent)
GALLERY_WORDMARK_RULE.note: The gold rule either side of the gallery's wordmark: `.wordmark-rule`'s `--metal-line`.

GALLERY_TABLETOP.note: The gallery's tabletop swatch, the table's material without its lighting: `.tabletop-chip`.

GALLERY_METAL_GOLD.note: The gallery's gold rule, amber at its ends and white-hot in its middle: `.metal-gold`.

GALLERY_BADGE.note: The shade behind the player badge in the gallery, fading out to its right: `.player-badge`. Its second stop is the web's `0.34em` at the gallery badge's 20.5px font size, a length rather than a share of the badge's width.

GALLERY_LAND_COUNT.note: The pale gold face of the gallery's land count badge.

GALLERY_WORDMARK_SHADE.note: The darker upper half of the gold rule either side of the gallery's wordmark, drawn over `GALLERY_WORDMARK_RULE`.
